top_signals.title: Container ship sinks in Strait of Hormuz as Iran steps up attacks
top_signals.summary: Iran has escalated its strikes on commercial ships transiting Hormuz in recent weeks, as it tries to choke off a rebound in crude oil exports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto exchange Kraken owner to buy European bank
top_signals.summary: Payward is purchasing Lithuania’s Saldo Bank as it seeks to become broader financial services company
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FMC Proposes Remedies to Counteract Unfavorable Spanish Shipping Conditions
top_signals.summary: After investigating reports of restrictive port practices by the Government of Spain, the Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) has determined that Spain has created unfavorable shipping conditions against U.S.-flagged vessels. As a result, the…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Treasury says largest U.S. banks let politics influence who received banking services
top_signals.summary: New Treasury Department findings may lend weight to President Donald Trump’s long-running grievance that major banks have discriminated against conservatives.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Eurobarometer survey highlights growing use of AI in European companies
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 14 Oct 2026 European businesses rely increasingly on artificial intelligence (AI). That is what the results of the latest Eurobarometer survey showed, published today.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2 trillion stablecoin market forecast to 2030 as supply growth stalls
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered Bank has pushed its $2 trillion stablecoin market forecast to 2030 from 2028 because supply growth has stalled this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
